name: ModelVariant105_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant105_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (eight spinning sprites fade in around a slot part, arc over to the other slot and burst); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the sprite and target points and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0, 1 or 2 by burst progress; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-122 and 252 images build it unchanged. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
